R01_hisat2: Our machine has little memory. Please use HISAT2 rather than STAR for the alignment.
R02_rsem: We would like the gene quantification to be done with RSEM.
R03_fastp: Please use fastp for adapter and quality trimming.
R04_no_trimming: Our reads have already been trimmed by the sequencing facility, so there is no need to trim them again.
R05_ribo_removal: Our libraries contain a lot of ribosomal RNA. Please remove the rRNA reads before alignment.
R06_umi: Our libraries contain unique molecular identifiers (UMIs), with the barcode in the first four bases of each read. Please take them into account.
R07_no_markdup: We do not want duplicate reads to be marked.
R08_no_spikein: We did not add the GFP spike-in to our samples, so please do not include it in the reference.
R09_gencode: Our annotation file comes from GENCODE.
R10_kallisto: We would prefer Kallisto rather than Salmon for the pseudo-alignment quantification.
R11_no_qc: We are short of time. Please skip the quality control steps.
R12_salmon_libtype_auto: We are unsure about the strandedness recorded for our samples. Please have the quantification infer the library type from the reads themselves instead.
R13_trim_quality_30: Please trim low-quality bases more stringently, with a Phred quality cut-off of 30 in Trim Galore.
